notes: Cinch Connectivity Solutions distributes this module. Ordering lists 125 Mbps and 1310 nm MMF; transmitter/receiver footnotes use BER = 10^-10 @ 1.25 Gbps, PRBS 27-1, NRZ. Optical sensitivity and TX power footnotes reference 62.5 MM fiber and FDDI/IEEE-802.3u or ANSI X3.297 / FC-PH-2. RX max optical input -8.0 dBm is the table Max for Optical Sensitivity PI. Supply current TX 180–230 mA, RX 150–170 mA at VCC 3.135–3.465 V; power in watts not stated. Conformal coating Parylene C (MIL-I-46058C Type XY). Link distance 2.0 km for 62.5/125 60 MHz·km and 50/125 500 MHz·km.
